overview: The commission approved a land transfer to support the Malden River Works project and reviewed conceptual designs for new residential and commercial buildings at Rivers Edge. Members also discussed procurement options for a new legal provider after their current firm announced its exit from municipal work.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the meeting held on September 26, 2022.

items.title: Commercial Street Parcel Transfer
items.summary: Approved the transfer of an MVDC-owned parcel to the Malden Redevelopment Authority to streamline grant applications and management for the Malden River Works park and resiliency project.

items.title: Legal Services Procurement
items.summary: Tabled the selection of a new legal services firm after being notified that the current firm is exiting municipal practice, with members discussing whether to utilize existing city contracts or issue a new RFP.

items.title: Rivers Edge Project Updates
items.summary: Reviewed conceptual designs for a new residential building and an office/lab building at Rivers Edge, including discussion of potential conservation land substitutions and utility easement access.
